items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In the Zulu parade? Uh-huh. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Zulus?

ctx.x: Yeah, well, he and Black Benny were real good buddies. Black Benny looked after Louis, you see, when he was a kid. You can read that up in the book. No, I didn't.
